name: Frigate NVR
description: Network video recorder for IP cameras with object detection (people, cars, animals).
notes: The admin password is printed in the container log on first start (Container Manager → Projects → app-frigate → Log). Recordings go to the 'surveillance' shared folder.
compose:
services:
  frigate:
    image: ghcr.io/blakeblackshear/frigate:stable
    restart: unless-stopped
    shm_size: "512mb"
    ports:
      - "8971:8971"
      - "8554:8554"
      - "8555:8555/tcp"
      - "8555:8555/udp"
    environment:
      - TZ=${TZ}
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ${SHARE:surveillance}:/media/frigate
      - type: tmpfs
        target: /tmp/cache
        tmpfs:
          size: 1000000000
